floor: L1 (West Gate, shop 169 / 西门一楼169商铺)
description_en: Viral Korean cuisine restaurant under the belloco brand. Known for tiramisu, charcoal-grilled beef bulgogi DIY tacos, spam kimchi fried rice with onsen egg, and potato mash.
description_zh: belloco旗下的爆款韩餐厅。招牌菜包括提拉米苏、炭烤牛肉不古歧DIY卷饼、午餐肉泡菜炒饭配温泉蛋、以及土豆泥。
